title: Can Claude replace Guru? 31/31 checks, 30 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Guru alternative, an internal knowledge base where every answer is a card with one owner and a review date, from one written spec: all 31 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 30 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:46): https://youtu.be/c0GKCgOTBgo
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/knowledge-base
Guru pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/guru

Guru does not publish prices: its pricing page says the investment is tailored to an organization and scoped on a call with its team (getguru.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
